visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, dressed in a black long-sleeved shirt and cream-colored overalls, sits at a white table in a bright indoor studio. Behind her, a black projector is mounted on a tall tripod. She gestures enthusiastically toward a white plate filled with green grapes while speaking directly to the camera. (2) A smartphone displaying a stopwatch is placed on the table next to the plate of grapes. The woman begins a challenge, rapidly picking up and eating the grapes one by one. Her facial expressions convey increasing strain and frantic effort as she chews. On-screen graphics like '+1', '+2', and explosive lines emphasize her movements. (3) Upon finishing the 12th grape, digital colorful confetti bursts across the frame. The woman claps her hands, smiles broadly, and looks visibly relieved. The lighting remains bright and consistent, with the studio background unchanged. (4) Two new bowls are placed on the table containing Taiwanese traditional snacks: green rice balls and large meatballs. The woman uses chopsticks to handle the meatballs. She attempts to consume them, but her facial expressions show humor and struggle due to the large size of the food items. (5) She picks up a spoon to eat a rice ball from a bowl of soup. As she eats, she immediately reacts to the intense heat of the food, waving her hands near her face and showing a wide-eyed, pained expression. Red graphic overlays and cartoonish monkey icons appear to highlight the 'hot' sensation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a bright, high-arousal female voice speaking energetically. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a synthesized beat. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect transitions into the main intro. (2) A rhythmic ticking clock sound becomes prominent as the eating challenge starts. A digital 'ding' SFX marks each second interval. The female voice exhibits vocal strain and muffled quality as she eats, interspersed with light background laughter from an off-screen male voice. (3) A loud 'ding-dong' chime followed by enthusiastic applause and cheering SFX signals the completion of the first challenge. The speaker exhales sharply, her voice returning to a clear, high-pitched professional narrative tone. (4) The music continues steadily. A metallic 'clink' of chopsticks hitting a bowl is heard. The speaker's pitch remains high and animated as she introduces the next food items. (5) A sudden sharp gasp and high-pitched 'Ow' sound indicate a reaction to heat. A cartoonish sliding whistle and high-energy monkey-like vocalizations follow, synchronized with comical graphic reveals. The music fades out abruptly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Challenge Rules -> Performance/Execution -> Celebration -> Pivot to Alternative Challenge -> Comedic Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers through a humorous food challenge, contrasting a foreign tradition with local Taiwanese variations and capturing the creator's genuine reactions to difficult eating tasks.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency variety-show style text overlays and sound effects to maintain high viewer engagement. The transition from a structured grape-eating challenge to a chaotic food-tasting segment provides a strong comedic contrast.
